name: Aldo Moro
contribution: An Italian statesman and prominent member of Christian Democracy and its centre-left wing.
legacy: This person was one of Italy's longest-serving post-war prime ministers, leading the country for more than six years.

checks.lead: Aldo Moro (Italian: [ˈaldo ˈmɔːro] ; 23 September 1916 – 9 May 1978) was an Italian statesman and prominent member of Christian Democracy (DC) and its centre-left wing. He served as prime minister of Italy for five terms from December 1963 to June 1968 and from November 1974 to July 1976.
